EXTRACT.

Extract for File No.: PF. 46464 Y. Box. 808. Name: GROEHL, Karl @ RETSLAV, Karl.

Original in File No.: OF. 3/37. FREE GERMAN YOUTH. Serial: V. 3. 136a. Dated: 21.8.43.

Original from: S.B. Report. Under Ref.: none. 21.8.43.

Extracted on: 31.8.43. by: PFR. Section: R.4.

From S.B. Report on public meeting held on 13.8.43. at Holborn Hall, Grays Inn Rd., W.C.1. under the auspices of FREE GERMAN YOUTH & the Editorial Board of "FREIE TRIBUNE".

The next speaker was Karl RETSLAV @ GROEHL @ ERDE. He evidently attacked the communists whose Party Line is muddled and incapable of giving a true lead to the workers. After dilating on the various political sommer- assaults which Communist policy has made during this war, RETSLAV began a tirade against the Moscow Ctte. He stated that it is a scandal that communists are collaborating with German officers and ex-Nazis, who have been guilty of so many crimes against civilians. It is intolerable that the Moscow Ctte. affects to use the black-white-red of the Second German Republic. The statements made by prisoners of war in Russia are so much rubbish - these men must say what they are instructed to say. From a general criticism RETSLAV then came down to personalities. He attacked "Colonel" Hans KAHLE who, he stated, has never been a Colonel, and hinted that KAHLE would be wiser if he kept very quiet and refrained from speaking at public meetings. Finally the audience became restive, and the Chairman had to ask RETSLAV to desist.

Heinz SCHMIDT, the next speaker, made some observations on RETSLAV's character as a politician, and referred to the fact that he had been thrown out of the German Underground Movement.

RETSLAV then intervened, and began a tirade of foul language.
